checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging.
Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass now deletes the legacy WeatheringOverlays primitive-cube root and reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as five combined non-colliding tapered/irregular mesh groups anchored to modeled construction sources. A benchmark scene-save gate re-applies and validates this invariant once DanchiHighDetail exists.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, and dry non-metallic weathering residue materials whose smoothness is structurally capped by QA.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing refresh and outdoor BlendProbesAndSkybox renderer policy.
Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics explicitly skips when the danchi authored-art slot is active.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with explicit foundation/grade, facade/glazing, environment and facade-weathering contracts. The weathering contract records physical source assemblies, dimensions, mounting/interfaces, exposure, dry-residue material parameters, geometry-vs-material split, sparse distribution rules and render-specific automatic fail conditions.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before capture. The new scene-save gate makes non-primitive facade weathering a persisted invariant whenever the detailed danchi exists, including saves performed during the capture preparation chain. The final scene reopen still re-validates lighting and refreshes realtime probes immediately before capture.
Capture contract records exact view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it.
No actual Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection only for this pass. Source counts and geometric/material constraints are machine-enforced by editor QA code but have not executed in Unity 6000.3.0f1 in this environment. The pass intentionally removes the legacy visible primitive weathering root during the persisted quality-build path. No native 3840x2160 render or 100% crop exists, so Visual Fidelity remains unscored and zero points are awarded from this work.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Weathering/context causality: visible facade marks now terminate at modeled sills, slab drip edges, rail base plates, the installed downpipe, grade contact or AC drain-hose terminations rather than free-form rectangles. Sparse rail rust and bounded splash height specifically target obvious procedural repetition.

Geometry/construction fidelity: legacy weathering Cube primitives are deleted and five combined purpose-built meshes carry tapered/irregular silhouettes with zero colliders. This directly reduces a critical automatic-fail risk from visible placeholder geometry in benchmark crops.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: dry residue materials are non-metallic and low-smoothness; rust is treated as oxide residue on concrete rather than metallic bulk steel, and the dry benchmark does not receive a generic wet sheen.

Texture/microdetail fidelity: window/balcony/rail marks vary deterministically in width, length and drift while retaining their physical catchment/source constraints, reducing stamped repetition at 100 percent crop scale.

Cinematic image quality: the pass is deliberately subtle and low-opacity so weathering supports scale/history without becoming a stylized overlay. Actual opacity, z-fighting and transparency sorting still require 4K evidence.
